items.title: Capital shadows — monitoring with repeated empty output
items.observation: Options / Event / Crypto / Sports shadows keep monitoring while output stays empty.
items.evidence: Empty live book persists; escalate cheap reversible live test (e.g. CPI NO ACT / TEST SMALL under L14) or scanner/universe/threshold change same cycle.
items.hypothesis: Empty output is evidence about the process (universe, scanner, threshold, model, or sourcing), not a permanent wait-and-watch default.
items.sampleNote: Pattern across lanes; firm at first weekly audit.
items.requiredBehavioralChange: Same operating cycle as another empty shadow result: change universe, scanner, threshold, model, or sourcing — or run a cheap reversible live test. Do not file another empty report with the process unchanged.
items.testMethod: Next empty cycle must show an explicit process change or cheap test logged same turn.
items.durablePrimitive: Capital scanner / threshold / workflow + Capital CEO activation rule

items.title: Foundry funnel — examined→0 advanced repeats
items.observation: Foundry repeatedly examines nominations with 0 advanced (examined→0 advanced).
items.evidence: Cheap Test stage + same-cycle deepen; Fri 2026-09-18 CHEAP_TEST_NOMINATED TEST SMALL×4 (not EMPTY).
items.hypothesis: Repeated examined→0 is evidence about threshold, sourcing, or challenge criteria — not only about individual nominations.
items.sampleNote: Promoted to Testing after Cheap Test ladder activation; measuring ACT/WATCH/REJECT under new process.
items.requiredBehavioralChange: Same cycle as another examined→0: review and change threshold, sourcing, or challenge criteria — or run a bounded process experiment. An empty report alone is incomplete.
items.testMethod: Measure Cheap Test ACT/WATCH/REJECT rate under new ladder.
items.metrics: Cheap Test ACT/WATCH/REJECT rate under new ladder
items.outcome: pending — Cheap Test ladder validation in flight

items.title: Presence engagement — EXP-02 voice/format (post EXP-01 FAIL)
items.evidence: EXP-01 FAIL + near-zero engagement pattern. EXP-02 live: 28/30 replies under required voice mix complete; engagement still 0.
items.hypothesis: Repeating the same voice/format after FAIL will not produce information; adapting voice and/or format will.
items.sampleNote: 28/30 EXP-02 replies logged; finish Mon window then closeout — no premature Confirmed.
items.requiredBehavioralChange: EXP-02: voice/format shift. Run the next 30 replies under the shifted voice/format; measure engagement vs EXP-01 window. Do not revert to the pre-FAIL identical voice/format mid-test.
items.testMethod: EXP-02 — next 30 replies after voice/format shift.
items.metrics: Reply engagement vs prior near-zero / EXP-01 FAIL baseline; identical voice/format repeats after FAIL → 0 during EXP-02
items.durablePrimitive: Presence content voice/format skill or routine (update only after EXP-02 result)
items.outcome: pending — 28/30 EXP-02 replies; engagement still 0; finish Mon window then closeout

items.title: Foundry reject — Lightspeed OEM wall
items.observation: OEM wall on Lightspeed successor blocks default Cheap Test nomination path.
items.evidence: Screen/challenge surfaced material OEM wall at Fri 2026-09-18 Learning Activation Audit; bypass thesis not established.
items.hypothesis: OEM-walled successors should not enter Cheap Test without an explicit bypass thesis.
items.requiredBehavioralChange: At screen/challenge, if OEM wall is material, REJECT or escalate with explicit bypass thesis — do not nominate OEM-walled successors into Cheap Test as default next step
items.testMethod: Audit screen/challenge decisions on OEM-walled nominations.
items.metrics: OEM-walled nominees entering Cheap Test without bypass thesis → 0
items.durablePrimitive: Foundry screen/challenge criteria + Cheap Test nomination gate
items.outcome: Confirmed — OEM wall = REJECT or explicit bypass thesis

items.title: Foundry reject — Ajera soft leftover / QB+PM
items.observation: Soft leftover + QB+PM stack nominations lack sharp wedge for Cheap Test.
items.evidence: Ajera soft leftover / QB+PM pattern surfaced at Fri 2026-09-18 Learning Activation Audit; wedge insufficient for default Cheap Test path.
items.hypothesis: Soft leftover + QB+PM stacks require a sharper wedge before Cheap Test; otherwise REJECT.
items.requiredBehavioralChange: Before Cheap Test on soft leftover + QB+PM stacks: demand sharper wedge or REJECT
items.testMethod: Audit Cheap Test nominations on soft leftover + QB+PM stacks for wedge quality.
items.metrics: Cheap Test entries on soft leftover + QB+PM without sharp wedge → 0
items.durablePrimitive: Foundry screen/challenge criteria + Cheap Test wedge gate
items.outcome: Confirmed — demand sharper wedge or REJECT
